title: Why Bikers Tap Their Helmet at You
hook: Ever see a biker tap the top of their helmet while riding?

script.narration: Ever see a biker tap the top of their helmet while riding? It is not a random gesture; it is a warning.
When a biker taps their helmet, they are signaling to other riders that there is a police officer or a speed trap ahead. It is a universal way to warn fellow road users to slow down.
script.visual_search: police cruiser parked on side of road

script.narration: Bikers often use these subtle hand signals to keep the group safe and aware of hazards that might not be visible yet. It is all about looking out for one another on the open road.
